sourceCodePolicy: Read-only git show at each archived task commit; UTF-8 display decoding, 5 MB per-file limit. No live runtime source dependency.
validationPolicy: Unique complete snippets (exact or indentation normalization), recorded revision validation, or substantial unique ordered code-token excerpt anchors with quoted literals preserved and unmatched/omitted text disclosed. No inferred bug lines.
originals: Original task files are distributed in the secprbench benchmark repository (data/roster.json records their hashes). The frozen ten-configuration result snapshot is identified by snapshotSha256 and is retained by the authors.
